title: Eco Circular Feed — Same-Polymer Reference/Recovered Control Coupon Plan
objective: Qualify a clean, segregated recovered thermoplastic feed against a virgin same-polymer reference before any mixed cleanup stream is admitted to UTP functional use.

first_route.material_family: PETG preferred for the first route only after exact on-hand resin/filament identity is source-bound; PLA may substitute only as a separately recorded same-polymer route.
first_route.control: virgin/reference material from the same declared polymer grade/product family used to define the recovered candidate
first_route.recovered_candidate: clean segregated print scrap/offcuts from that same known material family; service-aged, mixed-polymer, ocean-recovered, painted, filled, unknown or contaminated material is excluded from the first route
first_route.rule: reference and recovered arms must use the same declared geometry, process settings, conditioning method and measurement schema except for feed provenance/reprocessing history

evidence_boundary: This plan is not evidence that any recovered feed is qualified.
Recovered identity/provenance alone is insufficient; contamination, moisture/conditioning, processability and coupon performance remain measured gates.
No mixed ocean/municipal cleanup material enters the first control route.
A passing structural coupon does not automatically qualify electrical, dielectric, optical, pressure, electrochemical or biological-contact use.

conditional: density if volume can be measured adequately
tensile/flexural/compression strength using a declared standard/test geometry if suitable test equipment exists
thermal transition or rheology only when calibrated instruments and method are available
electrical/dielectric properties only in a separately qualified functional-feed route
forbidden_inference: do not infer polymer chemistry from appearance alone
do not infer safety/toxicity/ecotoxicity from a successful print
do not infer graphene/carbon conversion from generic recovered carbonaceous material
do not invent acceptance percentages without an intended-use requirement, material source or declared test method

acceptance_logic.before_run: declare intended use class, reference identity, coupon geometry, measurements and acceptance limits from source requirements or a documented engineering requirement
acceptance_logic.pass: recovered arm stays within all predeclared limits relative to the reference and has no unresolved contamination/provenance/process anomaly
acceptance_logic.hold: any identity ambiguity, mixed polymer, contamination uncertainty, conditioning failure, uncontrolled process change or failed measurement
acceptance_logic.promotion_ceiling: one qualified material/process/use-class coupon only; no blanket recovered-feed approval

next_escalation: repeat across lots/reprocessing cycles to establish variability
add chemical/contamination assays for externally recovered material
separately qualify conductive/filler/dielectric functional recovered feeds against virgin controls
only after those gates consider mixed municipal/ocean cleanup streams
